image_description: A Brown Pelican standing on a dark, wet rock at the edge of turquoise water. The bird is facing left, displaying its characteristic long bill with a gular pouch, white head and neck, and dark brown/grey body plumage. The background consists of rippling water with some white foam.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the massive, elongated bill structure with the visible gular pouch hanging below the lower mandible, consistent with pelican anatomy.

The tail feathers are visible at the rear, appearing short and consistent with the wedge shape typical of the species.
